{"id":1888601640,"question_id":4178,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1768717338,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1888601640/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Vowel-Consonant Score","memory":"9.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int vowelConsonantScore(string s) {\n        int vowel = 0 , conso = 0;\n        for(auto it : s)\n        {\n            if(isdigit(it) or it == ' ') continue;\n            else if(it == 'a' or it == 'e' or it == 'i' or it == 'o' or it == 'u') vowel++;\n            else conso++;\n        }\n\n        int score = 0;\n        if(conso > 0) score = floor(vowel/conso);\n        return score;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"vowel-consonant-score","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1507}
